```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
here::i_am("code/01_build_panel_dataset.Rmd")

library(here)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)

years <- 2017:2023
analysis_crs <- 5070

acs_dir <- here("data", "raw", "acs")
ev_dir <- here("data", "raw", "ev_stations")
rent_dir <- here("data", "raw", "acs_rent_burden")

shape_2010_dir <- here(
  "data", "raw", "census_boundaries", "2010"
)

shape_2020_file <- here(
  "data", "raw", "census_boundaries", "2020", "block_groups.shp"
)

smart_location_gdb <- here(
  "data", "raw", "smart_location", "SmartLocationDatabase.gdb"
)

output_file <- here(
  "data", "processed", "analysis_panel_2017_2023.csv"
)

dir.create(
  dirname(output_file),
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)
```

## Helper functions

```{r helpers}
to_numeric_clean <- function(x) {
  x <- dplyr::na_if(as.character(x), "-")
  x <- gsub("[^0-9.-]", "", x)
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

add_acs_prefix <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)

  ifelse(
    stringr::str_starts(x, "1500000US"),
    x,
    paste0("1500000US", x)
  )
}

assert_files_exist <- function(paths) {
  missing <- paths[!file.exists(paths)]

  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    stop(
      "The following required files are missing:\n",
      paste(missing, collapse = "\n")
    )
  }
}

read_rent_burden_year <- function(year) {
  path <- file.path(
    rent_dir,
    sprintf("ACSDT5Y%d.B25070-Data.csv", year)
  )

  assert_files_exist(path)

  readr::read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    dplyr::filter(GEO_ID != "Geography") |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      GEO_ID = as.character(GEO_ID),
      Year = year,
      renters_total = to_numeric_clean(B25070_001E),
      n_30_34 = to_numeric_clean(B25070_007E),
      n_35_39 = to_numeric_clean(B25070_008E),
      n_40_49 = to_numeric_clean(B25070_009E),
      n_50p = to_numeric_clean(B25070_010E)
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      burdened30_n = rowSums(
        dplyr::across(c(n_30_34, n_35_39, n_40_49, n_50p)),
        na.rm = FALSE
      ),
      burdened50_n = n_50p,
      rent_burden_30p = dplyr::if_else(
        renters_total > 0,
        100 * burdened30_n / renters_total,
        NA_real_
      ),
      rent_burden_50p = dplyr::if_else(
        renters_total > 0,
        100 * burdened50_n / renters_total,
        NA_real_
      )
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(
      GEO_ID,
      Year,
      renters_total,
      burdened30_n,
      burdened50_n,
      rent_burden_30p,
      rent_burden_50p
    )
}

calculate_ev_exposure <- function(
    polygons,
    points,
    distances_miles = c(0.5, 1, 2),
    projected_crs = analysis_crs) {

  stopifnot(inherits(polygons, "sf"))
  stopifnot(inherits(points, "sf"))

  polygons_projected <- sf::st_transform(
    polygons,
    projected_crs
  )

  points_projected <- sf::st_transform(
    points,
    projected_crs
  )

  output <- polygons

  for (distance in distances_miles) {
    distance_meters <- distance * 1609.344

    station_buffers <- sf::st_buffer(
      points_projected,
      dist = distance_meters
    )

    intersections <- sf::st_intersects(
      sf::st_geometry(polygons_projected),
      sf::st_geometry(station_buffers)
    )

    suffix <- stringr::str_replace(
      as.character(distance),
      "\\.",
      "_"
    )

    output[[paste0("WithinBuffer_", suffix, "mi")]] <-
      as.integer(lengths(intersections) > 0)

    output[[paste0("PointCount_", suffix, "mi")]] <-
      lengths(intersections)
  }

  output
}
```

## Read Census boundaries and create the 2010–2020 crosswalk

```{r geography-crosswalk}
shape_2010_files <- list.files(
  shape_2010_dir,
  pattern = "\\.shp$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

if (length(shape_2010_files) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No 2010 block-group shapefiles were found in:\n",
    shape_2010_dir
  )
}

assert_files_exist(shape_2020_file)

block_groups_2010 <- shape_2010_files |>
  purrr::map(
    ~ sf::st_read(.x, quiet = TRUE)
  ) |>
  dplyr::bind_rows()

if (!"GEOID" %in% names(block_groups_2010)) {
  stop("The 2010 block-group files do not contain a GEOID column.")
}

block_groups_2010 <- block_groups_2010 |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    GEOID10 = add_acs_prefix(GEOID)
  )

block_groups_2020 <- sf::st_read(
  shape_2020_file,
  quiet = TRUE
)

if (!"GEOID" %in% names(block_groups_2020)) {
  stop("The 2020 block-group file does not contain a GEOID column.")
}

block_groups_2020 <- block_groups_2020 |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    GEOID = add_acs_prefix(GEOID)
  )

smart_layers <- sf::st_layers(smart_location_gdb)
smart_layer_name <- smart_layers$name[[1]]

smart_location <- sf::st_read(
  smart_location_gdb,
  layer = smart_layer_name,
  quiet = TRUE
)

required_smart_columns <- c(
  "GEOID10",
  "STATEFP",
  "D1B",
  "D2A_EPHHM",
  "D4A",
  "NatWalkInd"
)

missing_smart_columns <- setdiff(
  required_smart_columns,
  names(smart_location)
)

if (length(missing_smart_columns) > 0) {
  stop(
    "The Smart Location layer is missing these columns: ",
    paste(missing_smart_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

smart_location <- smart_location |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    GEOID10 = add_acs_prefix(GEOID10),
    STATEFP = stringr::str_pad(
      as.character(STATEFP),
      width = 2,
      side = "left",
      pad = "0"
    ),
    D1B = to_numeric_clean(D1B),
    D2A_EPHHM = to_numeric_clean(D2A_EPHHM),
    D4A = to_numeric_clean(D4A),
    NatWalkInd = to_numeric_clean(NatWalkInd)
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    GEOID10 %in% block_groups_2010$GEOID10,
    STATEFP %in% c("11", "24", "42", "51")
  )

smart_5070 <- smart_location |>
  sf::st_make_valid() |>
  sf::st_transform(analysis_crs)

block_groups_2020_5070 <- block_groups_2020 |>
  sf::st_make_valid() |>
  sf::st_transform(analysis_crs)

intersection_areas <- suppressWarnings(
  sf::st_intersection(
    smart_5070 |>
      dplyr::select(
        GEOID10,
        D1B,
        D2A_EPHHM,
        D4A,
        NatWalkInd
      ),
    block_groups_2020_5070 |>
      dplyr::select(GEOID)
  )
)

intersection_areas$overlap_area <- as.numeric(
  sf::st_area(intersection_areas)
)

intersection_table <- intersection_areas |>
  sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(GEOID10),
    !is.na(GEOID),
    overlap_area > 0
  )

if (nrow(intersection_table) == 0) {
  stop("The 2010 and 2020 block-group layers did not intersect.")
}

# Assign each 2010 Smart Location block group to the 2020 block group
# with which it has the largest area of overlap.
overlap_crosswalk <- intersection_table |>
  dplyr::group_by(GEOID10) |>
  dplyr::slice_max(
    order_by = overlap_area,
    n = 1,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::select(
    GEOID10,
    GEOID,
    overlap_area
  )

# Several 2010 block groups can map to the same 2020 block group.
# Aggregate Smart Location variables so that there is exactly one row
# per 2020 GEOID before joining to annual ACS data.
smart_location_variables_2020 <- smart_location |>
  sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
  dplyr::select(
    GEOID10,
    D1B,
    D2A_EPHHM,
    D4A,
    NatWalkInd
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    overlap_crosswalk,
    by = "GEOID10"
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(GEOID)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(GEOID) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    D1B = weighted.mean(
      D1B,
      w = overlap_area,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    D2A_EPHHM = weighted.mean(
      D2A_EPHHM,
      w = overlap_area,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    D4A = weighted.mean(
      D4A,
      w = overlap_area,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    NatWalkInd = weighted.mean(
      NatWalkInd,
      w = overlap_area,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      c(D1B, D2A_EPHHM, D4A, NatWalkInd),
      ~ dplyr::na_if(.x, NaN)
    )
  )

# Use the 2020 polygons for the final analysis geography.
smart_location_2020 <- block_groups_2020 |>
  dplyr::select(GEOID) |>
  dplyr::inner_join(
    smart_location_variables_2020,
    by = "GEOID"
  )

duplicate_smart_geoids <- smart_location_2020 |>
  sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
  dplyr::count(GEOID) |>
  dplyr::filter(n > 1)

if (nrow(duplicate_smart_geoids) > 0) {
  stop("Duplicate 2020 GEOIDs remain in smart_location_2020.")
}

message(
  "2020 block groups with Smart Location data: ",
  nrow(smart_location_2020)
)
```

## Read annual rent-burden data

```{r rent-burden}
rent_burden_all <- purrr::map_dfr(
  years,
  read_rent_burden_year
)

duplicate_rent_rows <- rent_burden_all |>
  dplyr::count(GEO_ID, Year) |>
  dplyr::filter(n > 1)

if (nrow(duplicate_rent_rows) > 0) {
  stop("Duplicate GEO_ID–Year rows exist in the rent-burden files.")
}
```

## Build one annual dataset

```{r build-year}
build_one_year <- function(year) {
  philly_file <- file.path(
    ev_dir,
    sprintf("philadelphia_ev_%d.csv", year)
  )

  dmv_file <- file.path(
    ev_dir,
    sprintf("dmv_ev_%d.csv", year)
  )

  acs_file <- file.path(
    acs_dir,
    sprintf("%dACS-Data_DMV_Philly_Combined.csv", year)
  )

  assert_files_exist(
    c(philly_file, dmv_file, acs_file)
  )

  ev_stations <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    readr::read_csv(
      philly_file,
      show_col_types = FALSE
    ),
    readr::read_csv(
      dmv_file,
      show_col_types = FALSE
    )
  ) |>
    dplyr::select(
      dplyr::any_of(
        c(
          "EV.Network",
          "Latitude",
          "Longitude",
          "Open.Date"
        )
      )
    )

  required_ev_columns <- c("Latitude", "Longitude")
  missing_ev_columns <- setdiff(
    required_ev_columns,
    names(ev_stations)
  )

  if (length(missing_ev_columns) > 0) {
    stop(
      "EV files for ",
      year,
      " are missing: ",
      paste(missing_ev_columns, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  ev_stations <- ev_stations |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      Latitude = to_numeric_clean(Latitude),
      Longitude = to_numeric_clean(Longitude)
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(Latitude),
      !is.na(Longitude),
      dplyr::between(Latitude, -90, 90),
      dplyr::between(Longitude, -180, 180)
    ) |>
    dplyr::distinct(
      Latitude,
      Longitude,
      .keep_all = TRUE
    )

  if (nrow(ev_stations) == 0) {
    stop("No valid EV station coordinates were found for ", year, ".")
  }

  ev_points <- sf::st_as_sf(
    ev_stations,
    coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"),
    crs = 4326,
    remove = FALSE
  )

  # Do not explicitly select a geometry column by name.
  # sf keeps the active geometry automatically.
  block_group_base <- smart_location_2020 |>
    dplyr::select(
      GEOID,
      D1B,
      D2A_EPHHM,
      D4A,
      NatWalkInd
    ) |>
    sf::st_transform(4326)

  block_group_exposure <- calculate_ev_exposure(
    polygons = block_group_base,
    points = ev_points,
    distances_miles = c(0.5, 1, 2)
  ) |>
    sf::st_drop_geometry()

  duplicate_exposure_rows <- block_group_exposure |>
    dplyr::count(GEOID) |>
    dplyr::filter(n > 1)

  if (nrow(duplicate_exposure_rows) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Duplicate GEOIDs were created in EV exposure data for ",
      year,
      "."
    )
  }

  acs <- readr::read_csv(
    acs_file,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      GEO_ID = as.character(GEO_ID)
    )

  duplicate_acs_rows <- acs |>
    dplyr::count(GEO_ID) |>
    dplyr::filter(n > 1)

  if (nrow(duplicate_acs_rows) > 0) {
    stop(
      "The ACS file contains duplicate GEO_ID values for ",
      year,
      "."
    )
  }

  annual_rent_burden <- rent_burden_all |>
    dplyr::filter(Year == year) |>
    dplyr::select(-Year)

  annual_output <- acs |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      annual_rent_burden,
      by = "GEO_ID"
    ) |>
    dplyr::inner_join(
      block_group_exposure,
      by = c("GEO_ID" = "GEOID")
    ) |>
    dplyr::rename(
      PopDens = D1B,
      EmployeeDiversity = D2A_EPHHM,
      DistanceTransit = D4A,
      Walkability = NatWalkInd
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      dplyr::across(
        dplyr::any_of(
          c(
            "MedianRent",
            "MedianHouseholdIncome",
            "TotalStudents",
            "HighSchoolDiploma",
            "BachelorDegree",
            "MasterDegreeAndPlus",
            "TotalHH",
            "OwnerHH",
            "RenterHH",
            "TotalPopulation",
            "WhitePopulation",
            "BlackPopulation",
            "AsianPopulation",
            "NonHispanicPopulation",
            "HispanicPopulation",
            "HouseholdUnderPoverty",
            "HousingUnits",
            "VacantUnits",
            "PopDens",
            "EmployeeDiversity",
            "DistanceTransit",
            "Walkability"
          )
        ),
        to_numeric_clean
      ),
      black_per = dplyr::if_else(
        TotalPopulation > 0,
        100 * BlackPopulation / TotalPopulation,
        NA_real_
      ),
      hispanic_per = dplyr::if_else(
        TotalPopulation > 0,
        100 * HispanicPopulation / TotalPopulation,
        NA_real_
      ),
      white_per = dplyr::if_else(
        TotalPopulation > 0,
        100 * WhitePopulation / TotalPopulation,
        NA_real_
      ),
      asian_per = dplyr::if_else(
        TotalPopulation > 0,
        100 * AsianPopulation / TotalPopulation,
        NA_real_
      ),
      hs_per = dplyr::if_else(
        TotalStudents > 0,
        100 * HighSchoolDiploma / TotalStudents,
        NA_real_
      ),
      bachelor_per = dplyr::if_else(
        TotalStudents > 0,
        100 * BachelorDegree / TotalStudents,
        NA_real_
      ),
      master_per = dplyr::if_else(
        TotalStudents > 0,
        100 * MasterDegreeAndPlus / TotalStudents,
        NA_real_
      ),
      renter_per = dplyr::if_else(
        TotalHH > 0,
        100 * RenterHH / TotalHH,
        NA_real_
      ),
      poverty_hh_per = dplyr::if_else(
        TotalHH > 0,
        100 * HouseholdUnderPoverty / TotalHH,
        NA_real_
      ),
      rent_afford = dplyr::if_else(
        MedianRent > 0 &
          MedianHouseholdIncome > 0,
        MedianRent / MedianHouseholdIncome,
        NA_real_
      ),
      Year = year
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(MedianRent),
      MedianRent > 0,
      !is.na(MedianHouseholdIncome),
      MedianHouseholdIncome > 0,
      !is.na(PopDens),
      PopDens >= 0,
      !is.na(EmployeeDiversity),
      EmployeeDiversity >= 0,
      !is.na(DistanceTransit),
      DistanceTransit >= 0,
      !is.na(Walkability),
      Walkability >= 0
    )

  duplicate_annual_rows <- annual_output |>
    dplyr::count(GEO_ID) |>
    dplyr::filter(n > 1)

  if (nrow(duplicate_annual_rows) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Duplicate GEO_ID rows remain after joins for ",
      year,
      "."
    )
  }

  annual_output
}
```

## Build and save the complete panel

```{r build-panel}
panel_df <- purrr::map_dfr(
  years,
  build_one_year
) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    GEO_ID,
    Year
  )

duplicate_rows <- panel_df |>
  dplyr::count(
    GEO_ID,
    Year
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(n > 1)

if (nrow(duplicate_rows) > 0) {
  print(duplicate_rows)

  stop(
    "Duplicate GEO_ID–Year records were created."
  )
}

readr::write_csv(
  panel_df,
  output_file
)

message(
  "Saved analysis panel to:\n",
  output_file
)

message(
  "Final number of rows: ",
  nrow(panel_df)
)
```

## Quality-control summary

```{r quality-control}
panel_summary <- panel_df |>
  dplyr::group_by(Year) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_block_groups = dplyr::n(),
    share_within_0_5mi = mean(
      WithinBuffer_0_5mi,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    share_within_1mi = mean(
      WithinBuffer_1mi,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    share_within_2mi = mean(
      WithinBuffer_2mi,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    missing_rent_burden_30p = mean(
      is.na(rent_burden_30p)
    ),
    missing_rent_burden_50p = mean(
      is.na(rent_burden_50p)
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

panel_summary
```
